issues.description: The method name used to produce the developer experience description is inconsistent across artifacts: the problem statement and the template expect swiftExperienceDescription(), but the solution defines getExperienceDescription() and its Client uses swiftExperienceDescription(). This naming mismatch will confuse students and cause compilation errors when callers/reference implementations expect a different identifier.
issues.suggestedFix: Unify the identifier across all artifacts. Prefer matching the problem statement/template by renaming the solution method getExperienceDescription() to swiftExperienceDescription(), update the initializer to call swiftExperienceDescription(), and ensure Client calls swiftExperienceDescription(). Alternatively, change the template and problem text to use getExperienceDescription() consistently — but all three places must use the same name.
